minor.title: Not available under 18

paywall.title: Joyo AI on JoyoRogo is for Pro
paywall.body: The JoyoRogo engine answers by reading your food log and needs JoyoRogo Pro. With your own AI key, Joyo AI is free in this app.

unavailable.title: The JoyoRogo engine is not available yet
unavailable.body: The server does not support Joyo AI yet, or the feature is switched off. Try again later, or use your own key.

gate.ownFree: Your own key is free for everyone. You only pay your AI provider for what you use.

hostedConsent.title: Permission for Joyo AI on JoyoRogo

noProvider.title: Your own key is not set up
noProvider.body: Joyo AI with your own key needs one key from the AI provider you choose. The feature is free; usage is billed by the provider.

noKey.title: The key is not on this phone
noKey.body: The key for this provider was not found. It may have been deleted. Enter the key again. Nothing is sent before that.

noConsent.title: Permission to share data needed
noConsent.body: You have not agreed to sending data to the provider, or the wording changed since you last agreed. Nothing is sent until you agree.

badUrl.title: The server address cannot be used
badUrl.body: The custom server address is empty, wrong, or uses http outside your home network. Fix the address.

consent.ownRecipient: {{provider}} ({{host}}), straight from your phone without passing the JoyoRogo server
consent.hostedRecipient: the JoyoRogo server, which passes it to the AI model (Cloudflare Workers AI)
consent.lead: Each time you ask, this is sent:

data.body: Profile and targets: age, sex, height, goal, kcal, protein, carbs, fat and fiber targets, and target weight.
data.food: Food log: food names, grams, kcal, protein, carbs, fat and fiber for today and the last 7 days. Longer ranges (up to 90 days) are only read when the AI asks for them.
data.water: Water: glasses per day and the goal.
data.weight: Weight: the latest weight and its change over 14 days. A longer trend is only read when the AI asks for it.
data.fasting: Fasting: the pattern and eating window, if you fast.
data.chat: The chat: the questions and answers in this conversation, and the data the AI reads while answering.

consent.notSent: Menstrual cycle data, pregnancy or breastfeeding mode, name, email, photos, GPS location, device IDs and Strava data.
consent.terms: Once it reaches {{provider}}, the data is handled under their own terms and privacy policy. Read their terms on the {{provider}} site first.
consent.hostedKept: The JoyoRogo server does not store questions or answers. It only counts questions per day for the daily limit.
consent.sample: See a sample of the data
consent.gemini: Google's free key is used to improve Google products. Use a paid key or OpenRouter.
consent.agree: I agree to the data above being sent to {{provider}}
consent.agreeHosted: I agree to the data above being sent to the JoyoRogo server and its AI model
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw this at any time with Delete key in the Joyo AI settings.
consent.withdrawHosted: You can withdraw this at any time in the Joyo AI settings.

setup.title: Set up your own key
setup.intro: Use your own AI account, free in this app. The key is kept only on this phone, in secure storage, and is never synced.

hint.openrouter: OpenRouter: the safest way to start. You top up a prepaid balance, so usage is capped by it. Do not turn on auto top-up if you want a firm limit.
hint.openai: A key from the OpenAI platform. Billed by usage; set a monthly limit in your account.
hint.anthropic: A key from the Anthropic console. Billed by usage; set a monthly limit in your account.
hint.gemini: A key from Google AI Studio. Read the warning in step 3 before using a free key.
hint.custom: Any server that speaks the OpenAI format: LiteLLM, Ollama on your home network, or a company gateway.

url.label: Server address
url.hint: The API base address, usually ending in /v1.
url.invalid: The address must start with http:// or https://.
url.insecure: An http address is only allowed on your home network (localhost, 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x or .local). Use https so your key and data do not cross the internet unencrypted.

key.label: API key
key.pasteEmpty: The clipboard is empty. Copy the key from the provider's page first.
key.tip: Create a key just for JoyoRogo and set a monthly spending limit in the provider account.
key.revoke: Revoke or delete the key at any time on the key page of the provider account. Deleting the key in JoyoRogo only removes it from this phone; the same key stays valid at the provider until you revoke it there.

test.hint: The test only sends one short message, with none of your data.

setup.needs: Fill in the key and model, then switch on both agreements in step 3.
setup.saved: Key saved. Joyo AI now uses your own key.
setup.saveFailed: The key could not be saved on this phone. Try again.

engine.free: Your own key is free for everyone. You only pay your AI provider for what you use.

limits.title: Limits and speed
limits.ceilingHint: Kept on this phone. One answer can use several calls, because the AI reads data through separate calls.
limits.fastHint: Asks the model not to think at length. Faster and cheaper, sometimes less thorough. Only has an effect when the provider's server supports it.
limits.fastFieldsHint: A JSON object sent to your server in place of the built-in ones. Leave empty for the defaults.
limits.fastFieldsBad: Not a valid JSON object, so the defaults are used.

data.title: Data on this phone
data.sent: See the data that is sent
data.sentHint: As it would go with the next question
data.chatsHint: Chats are kept on this phone
data.usageHint: Counted on this phone only, for your own key
data.deleteChatsMessage: All your chats with Joyo AI are deleted from this phone. Your key and settings stay.
data.deleteKeyMessage: The key is deleted from this phone and the permission to share data with {{provider}} is withdrawn. The key itself is still valid in your {{provider}} account: revoke or delete it on your account's key page so it cannot be used any more. If this is the provider in use, Joyo AI goes back to the JoyoRogo engine.
data.withdraw: Withdraw permission for the JoyoRogo engine
data.withdrawMessage: Joyo AI on JoyoRogo will not answer until you agree again. Chats on this phone stay as they are.
data.deleteAllMessage: Every key, permission, setting, chat and usage count of Joyo AI is deleted from this phone, and Joyo AI goes back to the JoyoRogo engine. The keys stay valid at the provider until you revoke them there.
data.allDeleted: All Joyo AI data deleted from this phone
data.deleteFailed: Could not delete it. Try again.
data.intro: This is the data that goes with every question, built again from your data each time. This page only shows it and sends nothing.
data.failed: The sample cannot be built right now. Try reloading.
data.toolsTitle: What the AI can read while answering
data.toolsIntro: The AI decides when to read these. All of it is read-only; nothing can change your records. The results are sent along with the answer.

tools.get_day: One day of the food log: foods, grams, kcal, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, targets, water, fasting
tools.get_range: Daily totals up to 90 days: kcal, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, water
tools.get_weight_trend: Weight trend over 7 to 365 days, computed by the app
tools.get_targets: Your kcal, macro, fiber and weight targets
tools.search_foods: Nutrition facts of one food from our food table, per 100 g and per portion
tools.compare_foods: Comparing several foods (fiber, protein, kcal, carbs, fat) from our table
tools.fits_today: Whether a food fits what is left of today's kcal, protein and fiber
